sessionRewind.dialog.title: Rewind
sessionRewind.dialog.desc: Restore this conversation to an earlier message.
sessionRewind.dialog.descConfirm: Remove this message and everything after it from the conversation.
sessionRewind.toast.done: Rewound. The original message is back in the composer.
sessionRewind.toast.draft: Rewound. The composer already had content, so it was kept.
sessionRewind.toast.noComposer: Rewound, but no composer was found.
sessionRewind.error.busy: Stop the current turn first (Esc), then rewind.
sessionRewind.error.badTarget: That message could not be located.
sessionRewind.error.notOnSurface: That message was shadowed by a compaction summary and cannot be rewound.
